name: Broadcast
summary: Post a channel update and watch rings roll out from a mast across a city of follower lights
about: A one-to-many channel composer over a canvas city of follower dots. Broadcast charges up the mast, then rings roll out over the ground and light every follower they reach while reactions float up. The post lands in the feed with live reach, views and reaction counts, and the city settles back down afterwards.
how: Write an update for your followers and pick a photo to attach, or No photo.
Press Broadcast (or Ctrl or Cmd + Enter).
Watch the reach counter and bar climb as the rings spread.
The post in the feed fills in its views and reactions, then shows Delivered.
